title: Bid Schema v0.1
description: Shape of the structured AI extraction for a single vendor proposal. Drafted from the actual Apex Electrical proposal fixture (sample-data/bids/apex_electrical_proposal.pdf) per Architecture-Amendments-v1.0.md Amendment 5 -- not designed in the abstract before a representative document existed. Used both to validate pipeline output and as the Anthropic tool input_schema (src/ai/anthropic_provider.py), so extraction is schema-constrained at the model call itself.

base_bid.description: The vendor's total base bid amount in USD, exactly as stated in the proposal summary.

allowances.description: Dollar allowances carried within the proposal, with whether each is already inside the base bid.

alternates.description: Priced alternates, with whether each is already inside the base bid.

scope_assertions.description: Status of specific scope items the pipeline asked about. Every requested key must be present -- 'NotFound' is a valid and expected answer, never omitted or silently treated as Excluded.

citations.description: Page/section location for every extracted fact, keyed by a field label (e.g. 'base_bid', 'lighting_fixture_allowance', 'alternate_a1'). Lets a human reviewer jump straight to the source instead of re-reading the whole proposal.

confidence_tier.description: Model's self-assessed confidence in this extraction. Never a numeric percentage -- see docs/architecture-review.md Section 2 on avoiding false precision.
